blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Section 11.5 expressly permits Ripple to blacklist addresses from sending or receiving RLUSD, freeze balances, and burn RLUSD in a wallet under applicable law or internal compliance policies. Ethereum's verified StablecoinUpgradeableV2 exposes pauseAccounts and clawback; the pinned XRPL issuer flags retain freeze capability. This replaces an inference from centralized governance with direct issuer terms.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: RLUSD remains native Ripple/SCTC issuance on Ethereum, XRPL, Base, Optimism, Ink and Unichain. The five reviewed EVM token deployments additionally authorize a Wormhole NTT manager to burn and mint RLUSD. Each pinned manager is in burning mode, with one Wormhole transceiver, threshold one, Guardian set 7 containing 19 addresses, and issuer-controlled weighted MultiSign administration. Native issuance is not a third-party wrapped reserve claim, but external message validation and issuer upgrade/peer/rate-limit authority are real control risks; neither native status nor small sampled balances removes them. XRPL issued-currency issuance remains separate from the XRPL EVM peer.
